description_en: Checks whether a datasource with the specified name already exists under the current tenant. This operation is used as a pre-check before creating or renaming a datasource
description_zh: 按数据源名称校验是否已存在同名数据源，用于新建或改名前的前置检查
name: ExecMetaDataComponentName

parameters.help_en: The datasource name to check. The system performs an exact match against non-deleted datasources under the current tenant
parameters.help_zh: 待校验的数据源名称，按名称精确匹配当前租户下未删除的数据源
parameters.name: ds_name

data.description_en: The name check result. A value of true indicates that a datasource with the same name already exists. A value of false indicates that the name is not in use
data.description_zh: 名称校验结果：true-已存在同名数据源，false-该名称未被占用

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies this call. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于唯一标识本次调用；排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, use errCode and errMessage to troubleshoot the issue
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
